Halifax Regional Police:

"Traffic Advisory – Bayers Lake

Police are assisting Halifax Regional Fire and Emergency with the response to a fire at Susies Lake in Halifax.  Police are asking the public to avoid the Bayers Lake area. Evacuations and street closures are underway.  Lessening the traffic congestion will help crews respond to the fire and allow those evacuating to leave safely."
